name: compromised_r7
description: R3->R8 on the sample topology. At step 2 router R7 is treated as compromised: every link incident to R7 gets security_risk 0.95 (above the 0.65 hard limit) and a small loss bump. The initial AI path R3-R5-R7-R8 uses R7, so the hard-constraint penalty should force a reroute. Metric-level simulation only.
